signature_moves: Live disk-telemetry feed in a menu-bar panel: 'LIVE ACTIVITY / writing now' rows show caches growing in real time with green up-triangle deltas ('340.5 MB'), 'just now/5s' timestamps and amber 'new' badges — the product thesis rendered as a running feed, not a static scan
Scale-as-hierarchy hero: a ~36pt '120.3 MB' reclaimable figure answers the user's one question pre-attentively; everything else defers
Brand-sparkle continuity: the icon's 4-point sparkle reappears as the in-panel header glyph
defects: Non-native header casing — tracked-UPPERCASE section headers where native grammar wants sentence-case system-font semibold (SwiftUI-multiplatform tell)
Non-native selection grammar — trailing checkmark.circle.fill / hollow-ring toggles instead of macOS inset-rounded accent-fill row selection
iOS-idiom icon chips — coloured rounded-tile SF Symbol tiles rather than plain symbols/file icons
Contrast Dilution (estimated) — secondary/tertiary white metadata and hollow rings/separators likely below 4.5:1 / 3:1 on the mid-blue glass

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product on Liquid Glass — dark glass panel, one electric/system-blue accent, big confident numeral, dense-calm feed; the model-default dev-tool look, but here it is platform-native (system accent on real glass), which is the stated reason it is legitimate

psychology: Von Restorff / signal-detection — the single saturated blue 'Clean Selected' CTA is the one different thing, found instantly against quiet glyphs
Processing fluency / first-impression — the giant hero number answers 'how much can I reclaim?' in one figure, a thesis-statement viewport
Zeigarnik & goal-gradient — '2 selected · 120.3 MB found' progress framing plus a live-growth feed create a low-grade nag that caches keep filling
Feedback / Doherty threshold — 'writing now', 'just now', '5s' give sub-second live telemetry; the panel feels alive
Colour-never-alone (respected) — green growth, amber 'new', blue selection are each glyph/label-paired, so three reserved colours stay disciplined rather than collapsing into noise
notes: No standalone UI screenshots were supplied — only meta.json, a 256px icon.webp, and a 1200x630 marketing COVER composite. The app evidence is the menu-bar popover inside the cover; brand evidence (giant 'Cachesweep' wordmark, Download DMG / Go to GitHub buttons, 'Free & open source · MIT · macOS 15+ · 13 languages') was kept separate and not tokenised. All UI values are logical-point estimates at ~1x render scale, provenance (estimated)(inferred); the panel is a single dark/glass surface so there is no light-mode, settings, empty-state, or focus-state evidence. Panel background is Liquid Glass tinted by the blue/purple wallpaper, so no fixed bg hex is claimable. Lineage is native (SwiftUI MenuBarExtra) with med confidence — several SwiftUI-multiplatform/iOS list idioms (uppercase headers, circular-check selection, tinted icon chips, ~44px rows) are recorded as tells and must NOT feed macOS canon. Icon is being digested separately (cachesweep-icon.json exists) per Workflow B; this file is Workflow A only. Contradiction to watch at synthesis: this app's comfortable menu-bar density vs the kit's dense 24-28pt control expectation — legitimate for a menu-bar panel, but do not learn its row height as general mac list density.
